verdict.rationale: Clerky is a self-contained legal document platform where startups and attorneys work directly inside Clerky's own hosted workspace; there is no evidence of an embeddable widget, iframe, SDK, or API for integrating Clerky's e-signature/document experience into a third-party app or website. This is a category mismatch — Clerky is a destination product, not an embeddable e-signature component like DocuSign/HelloSign, so the story does not apply to it.
